relevance_note: Retrospective MR series of 11 adult-onset Alexander disease patients with per-patient clinical, imaging and GFAP mutation tables: "Table 3: Missense mutations of the GFAP gene in 11 patients with AOAD".
method_note: Read the whole paper; a Python script (scratch dir) transcribed Tables 1-3 cell by cell and built spans as row prefixes from the label cell through the target cell; output checked against the tables. Labels: the text calls patients 'patient 1'..'patient 11'; tables print 'Pt/Age/Sex' as e.g. '1/26/M' (patient number/age/sex). The table age is recorded as age at last evaluation; the paper does not define it (could be age at MRI or at study). Table 1 'Disease Duration (y)' was not converted to an onset age (no age at onset stated). Table 1 symbols: legend defines '+' (moderate to severe) and '±' (mild) only; '-' is undefined, so '-' cells are 'not reported'. '(f)' (familial case, patients 1, 7, 9, 11) is not a phenotype; the relatives are not described individually and get no rows, except the father of patient 11 (died of a similar neurologic disorder with identical MR findings). Mappings: spastic paraparesis -> spasticity and limb weakness; shoulder girdle wasting & weakness (patient 7) -> limb weakness; palatal myoclonus -> palatal tremor; nystagmus/diplopia -> eye movement item; sphincter disturbances/dysautonomia -> autonomic item. Table 2 'Supratentorial Periventricular White Matter Abnormalities' -> cerebral white matter abnormality (observed); 'Absent' (patients 7, 8, 10) is recorded as excluded feature rows but the broader checklist item is left not reported; the 'periventricular rim' checklist item is left not reported because the paper describes a periventricular band of signal change, not a rim. 'No patient had abnormalities in the basal ganglia' excludes basal ganglia abnormality for all (group statement) but not the composite basal ganglia/thalamic checklist item. Patient 2 postcontrast study 'Not performed'. Patients 5 and 9 had 'a normal neurologic examination' (D-27: recorded as 'abnormal neurologic examination' excluded; nothing more specific excluded). Variants: Table 3 for patients 1-10; footnote markers (*, †, ‡) stripped from values. Zygosity/type from 'All of the patients but 1 carried heterozygous missense nucleotide changes' (patient 11 is the exception per footnote §). Patient 11's p.D157N, which the authors call a 'rare polymorphism' with 'no causative mutations', was left out as a variant the authors dismiss as non-causal. Pathogenicity 'pathogenic' from 'we found pathogenic GFAP mutations in 10 patients'. No parental testing, inheritance or transcript stated. Prior reports: 'The first 2 patients had already been reported. 17,18'; molecular data of patients 3 and 6 reported previously (ref 19); footnote * says p.L359P, p.S393I and p.R70Q were first found in these patients (refs 17, 18, 19), so patient 4 may also be in ref 19 (not stated). Group-level DWI/MRS results for the 'remaining 4 patients' were not assigned to individuals. Possible contradiction: Table 2 marks patient 3 with '(garl)' while the text says garlands were 'questionable in patient 3'; recorded as observed with detail 'questionable'. Publication year is not printed (received 2007, accepted 2008), so year is null.
